routes.title: The Kurobe gorge by open trolley

image.alt: A Kurobe Gorge Railway train on a red bridge above turquoise water and forested slopes

routes.title: The Sea of Japan coast on the Resort Shirakami
routes.teaser: Akita → Aomori · the sea on the left for 90 km
routes.season: All year; runs daily in November 2026, on set dates from December to February
routes.notice: All ordinary seats are reserved. In November 2026 trains run daily; from December to February only on set dates, so check JR East for your day.

image.alt: Sunset over the Sea of Japan and a rocky shore through a sightseeing train window

routes.title: Furano Line flower fields and the Tokachi mountains
routes.teaser: Biei → Furano · Tokachi mountains on the left
routes.season: Summer for flowers; clear days in any season for the Tokachi mountains
routes.notice: The Furano-Biei Norokko made its final run on September 23, 2026. JR Hokkaido has announced selected dates from July 1 through September 2027 for the new Blue Star 'Hill Colors' train between Asahikawa and Furano.

image.alt: Lavender fields and distant mountains through the open window of a wooden train

routes.title: The Sea of Okhotsk and drift ice on the Senmo Line

routes.season: Winter for drift ice; sea conditions change daily
routes.notice: Ryuhyo Monogatari is seasonal, not a year-round train. JR Hokkaido has announced service on January 30–31 and February 1–28, 2027; March service is planned, but its exact dates had not been published as of November 18, 2026.

image.alt: A green sightseeing train beside drift ice in the Sea of Okhotsk, seen from Kitahama Station

routes.title: The Tadami River bridges through the mountain valley
